_comment: Manifest of third-party 3D assets sampled for INTERNAL reference use.
Meshes here are never served to the public. Customers receive a rendered image
of their own build, never a source file. Every entry must state its licence and,
if CC-BY, the author to credit. Entries with no licence are REJECTED by the gate,
because an unlicensed upload is not public domain.
Verdicts are computed by app/Services/ThreeD/AssetLicenceGate.php. Run
php scripts/verify-3d-licence-gate.php to check the policy and
php scripts/verify-3d-licences.php to check this manifest.
licence      EXACT string shown on the asset page - do not paraphrase
attribution  creator name + page URL, required for anything CC-BY
url          direct link to the asset page
purpose      what we used it for (proportions, material study, ...)
_allowed: CC0 / Public Domain only, or CC-BY with a completed attribution field.
_rejected: CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-ND, Editorial, Personal Use, or anything unstated.
